data.name: Empty Mind
data.description: A black asp with this ki power can choose to lower the number of ki points in his ki pool by 3 when he recovers his ki points for the day. If he does so, he gains the benefits of mind blank for 24 hours.

raw_tokens.value: 1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Forbidden Ki Power ~ Greater Hidden Magic
